name: How do LIFT classes compare to personal training for strength building?
description: LIFT classes offer structured strength training with coaching in a group, while personal training provides one-on-one customized programming.

mainEntity.name: How do LIFT classes compare to personal training for strength building?

acceptedAnswer.text: LIFT classes offer a cost-effective way to build strength in a motivating group environment with expert coaching on foundational movements. While personal training provides one-on-one customized programming and undivided attention, LIFT classes at Cave Training provide structured, progressive workouts and form correction within a small group, fostering community and accountability. The main tradeoff is the level of individual programming versus the dynamic group setting and shared experience.
